entries.body:
Okay. Dinner last night was really good. Annoyingly good, actually.

First, he was late. Twenty minutes. But he texted me, explained what was happening, and apologized when he got there. So I don't really have a complaint about the lateness itself. I appreciated that he told me.

And then he was just…really good company. We talked for hours. He remembered something I told him about a work situation and asked me how it turned out. I like that. I don't want to have to reintroduce myself every time I see someone.

He also challenged me on something we were talking about. Not in an obnoxious way. He actually made a good point. I really like how intelligent he is. And he's funny. And obviously I'm attracted to him. Very attracted to him.

His hands are also extremely nice. I know that's a ridiculous thing to say, but I have a criterion for this. I am allowed to have a preference.

He checked his phone once during dinner because something was happening at work. He explained it, apologized, and put it away. That didn't bother me much. I understand that his job is demanding. What bothers me is that sometimes I don't hear from him for most of the day, and then when we're together he's completely attentive.

I don't want to be unreasonable. I don't need a minute-by-minute update. But I also don't want a relationship where I only feel like I exist when I'm physically in the same room as him.

The good thing is that he actually made the next plan. I didn't have to bring it up or hint around it. He said we should do something next weekend, and made the reservation, again. He confirmed this morning.

I think he likes me. I just don't know whether the communication thing is a difference in style or something that will become a bigger problem. One amazing date doesn't change things or answer that question.

And I know I'm very attracted to him, and I unfortunately like him a lot. I need to make sure I'm not letting that make me too generous about things that actually matter to me or that I'm making excuses that shouldn't slide.
